# Master Services Agreement (MSA) — Template

> **Draft template:** Complete every `[placeholder]`, select or remove bracketed alternatives, and have qualified counsel review this agreement before signing. This template is not legal advice. Each project must also have a signed Statement of Work (SOW).

## 1. Parties and effective date

This Master Services Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered into on **[effective date]** (“Effective Date”) by and between:

- **[Lextel legal entity name]**, a **[entity type and jurisdiction]**, with its principal address at **[address]** (“Lextel”); and
- **[Client legal entity name]**, a **[entity type and jurisdiction]**, with its principal address at **[address]** (“Client”).

Lextel and Client are each a “Party” and together the “Parties.”

## 2. Agreement structure and project scope

2.1 This Agreement sets the general terms for services provided by Lextel. The scope, deliverables, timeline, fees, and project-specific assumptions will be described in one or more SOWs signed by both Parties.

2.2 No project work is authorized until the applicable SOW is signed. If an SOW conflicts with this Agreement, **[the SOW controls only for its project-specific terms / this Agreement controls]**. Any amendment must identify the provision being changed and be signed by both Parties.

2.3 Services may include custom ERP implementation, web application development, or related work only to the extent expressly described in an SOW.

## 3. Responsibilities and collaboration

3.1 Lextel will perform the services with reasonable professional care and provide the deliverables stated in the applicable SOW.

3.2 Client will appoint a project contact, provide timely decisions and accurate requirements, supply lawful access to systems and materials, and ensure it has the rights needed for Lextel to use materials supplied by Client.

3.3 Client-caused delays, unavailable third-party services, or changes in requirements may affect the schedule, fees, or scope. The Parties will document material impacts through a written change order under the SOW.

## 4. Fees, invoicing, and expenses

4.1 Client will pay the fees and according to the schedule specified in the applicable SOW. Unless the SOW states otherwise, invoices are due within **[number] days** of receipt.

4.2 Fees are **[inclusive / exclusive]** of applicable taxes. Client is responsible for taxes imposed on the transaction, excluding taxes on Lextel’s net income, as required by applicable law.

4.3 Pre-approved out-of-pocket expenses will be **[reimbursed at cost / treated as included in the fees]**. Any disputed invoice must be raised in writing within **[number] days**; undisputed amounts remain payable when due.

4.4 If an undisputed amount remains overdue, Lextel may, after **[number] days’** written notice, suspend affected services until payment is made, to the extent permitted by law.

## 5. Changes and acceptance

5.1 Either Party may request a scope change. Lextel will assess its impact on deliverables, fees, and schedule. No change is binding until both Parties approve it in writing.

5.2 Deliverable review and acceptance criteria are set out in the applicable SOW. Any acceptance period, correction process, and treatment of silence must be expressly stated there.

## 6. Intellectual property

6.1 Each Party retains ownership of its pre-existing materials, software, tools, processes, and know-how (“Background Materials”).

6.2 Subject to full payment of all amounts due for the applicable SOW, ownership or license rights in project deliverables will be as follows: **[select and complete one: (a) Lextel assigns specified deliverable rights to Client; (b) Lextel grants Client a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive license; or (c) other arrangement: describe].** The SOW must identify any excluded Background Materials and third-party components.

6.3 Lextel retains ownership of its Background Materials and grants Client **[a license scope]** to any such materials incorporated into a deliverable, solely as needed to use that deliverable.

6.4 Third-party and open-source components remain subject to their own license terms. Lextel will identify material third-party dependencies when reasonably requested or as stated in the SOW.

6.5 Client grants Lextel a limited, non-exclusive right to use Client materials only to perform the services and meet its obligations under this Agreement.

## 7. Confidentiality

7.1 “Confidential Information” means non-public information disclosed by a Party that is identified as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature and the circumstances of disclosure.

7.2 The receiving Party will use Confidential Information only to perform or receive services under this Agreement, protect it with reasonable care, and disclose it only to personnel or professional advisers who need to know it and are bound by confidentiality obligations.

7.3 Confidential Information does not include information the receiving Party can demonstrate is public without breach, already lawfully known, independently developed, or lawfully received from another source without a duty of confidentiality.

7.4 A Party may disclose Confidential Information when legally required, provided it gives prior notice where legally permitted. These obligations continue for **[number] years** after disclosure; trade secrets remain protected while they qualify as trade secrets under applicable law.

## 8. Data protection and security

8.1 Each Party will comply with data-protection and privacy laws applicable to its role and activities under the Agreement.

8.2 Client determines and documents the lawful basis and purposes for personal data processed through a Client system. Lextel will process such data only as necessary to perform the services and according to Client’s documented instructions.

8.3 Before Lextel processes personal data on Client’s behalf, the Parties will enter into any required data-processing terms covering processing details, security measures, subprocessors, assistance, retention, and deletion or return of data.

8.4 The SOW will identify relevant hosting, backups, access controls, and security responsibilities. Neither Party will access or transfer data beyond what is necessary for its responsibilities.

## 9. Warranties and support

9.1 Each Party represents that it has authority to enter into this Agreement.

9.2 Any warranty period, defect correction process, maintenance, service levels, or ongoing support must be expressly stated in the applicable SOW or a separate support agreement.

9.3 Except for express warranties in this Agreement or an SOW, services and deliverables are provided **[to the extent permitted by law: “as is” / describe other warranty]**. No warranty should be read to guarantee a particular business outcome or uninterrupted operation of third-party services.

## 10. Indemnification

10.1 **[Optional—complete with counsel:]** Each Party (the “Indemnifying Party”) will defend and indemnify the other Party against **[specify covered third-party claims, losses, process, exclusions, and conditions]** arising from **[specified conduct or breach]**.

10.2 The indemnified Party will give prompt notice, provide reasonable cooperation, and allow the Indemnifying Party to control the defense and settlement, provided no settlement may impose liability or an admission on the indemnified Party without its prior written consent.

## 11. Limitation of liability

11.1 To the extent permitted by applicable law, neither Party will be liable for **[specify excluded categories of indirect or consequential loss]**.

11.2 Each Party’s aggregate liability arising out of an SOW will not exceed **[amount or fees paid/payable during a stated period]**, except for **[carefully define any exclusions or separate caps, including whether confidentiality, data protection, IP, indemnity, fraud, or willful misconduct are treated differently]**.

11.3 Nothing in this Agreement limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited. The Parties should have counsel review this section and align it with any indemnity and data-protection terms.

## 12. Term, suspension, and termination

12.1 This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues until terminated under this section. Each SOW continues for its stated term unless completed or terminated.

12.2 Either Party may terminate this Agreement or an affected SOW for material breach if the breach is not cured within **[number] days** after written notice. **[Add any termination-for-convenience right, notice period, and applicable fee.]**

12.3 On termination, Client will pay for services performed and approved non-cancellable commitments through the effective termination date. The Parties will coordinate return or deletion of Confidential Information and Client data, subject to legal retention duties and any agreed transition assistance.

12.4 Sections that by their nature should survive termination—including payment obligations, confidentiality, intellectual property, liability, and dispute terms—will survive.

## 13. General terms

13.1 **Independent contractors.** The Parties are independent contractors; this Agreement does not create a partnership, agency, or employment relationship.

13.2 **Subcontractors.** Lextel may use subcontractors to perform services and remains responsible for their work and applicable confidentiality obligations. **[Add any approval requirement.]**

13.3 **Force majeure.** Neither Party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control, excluding payment obligations. The affected Party will notify the other and take reasonable steps to reduce the impact.

13.4 **Assignment.** Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the other Party’s written consent, except **[permitted successor or corporate transaction exception]**.

13.5 **Notices.** Formal notices must be sent to the addresses and contacts below by **[permitted delivery method]**. Email notice is **[permitted / not permitted]** for **[specified notices]**.

13.6 **Entire agreement; severability; waiver.** This Agreement and signed SOWs are the entire agreement on their subject matter. If a term is unenforceable, the remaining terms continue. A failure to enforce a term is not a waiver.

13.7 **Governing law and disputes.** This Agreement is governed by the laws of **[jurisdiction]**, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. The Parties will first attempt in good faith to resolve disputes through **[negotiation/mediation and time period]**. Unresolved disputes will be submitted to **[courts/arbitration, location, and rules]**.
